versions.content: For Physical Channels switching to CANIF_TX_OFFLINE mode CanIf shall: • prevent forwarding of transmit requests CanIf_Transmit() of associated L-PDUs to CanDrv (return E_NOT_OK to the calling upper layer modules), • clear the corresponding CanIf transmit buffers, • prevent invocation of transmit confirmation callback services of the upper layer modules. • enable invocation of receive indication callback services of the upper layer mod- ules.
